source.text: Laut aktuellen Zahlen ist der Umsatz in der Gastronomie in Deutschland um 4 Prozent zurückgegangen. Restaurant Besuche sind den Deutschen zu teuer geworden. #Gastronomie #restaurant #essengehen #essen #inflation @Kemal Üres | Gastro-Flüsterer @ReDo - Gastro Coach @Gastronomicus 3.0

reference.notes: No venue is named, and the claims concern Germany's restaurant industry, not Berlin, so they take subject none. The 4 percent figure is neither minutes nor money, so it has no amount. The fall in revenue is treated as a fact, not a change, because change applies only to a single place.
